note: The frozen task set for the CAPTCHA and DataDome work (ROADMAP PA item 6, ADR 0005 third_party_captcha_solver). FREEZE RULE: frozen 2026-10-25; from then on no task is dropped, replaced or edited, and every task stays in every denominator (run-set.mjs refuses this file when its tasks no longer hash to manifestSha256). A wrong task is not fixed here: write a new version (captcha-tasks.v2.json) and say why in a dated record. Tasks with origin saved_run come from saved runs whose answer was blocked with captcha, bot_detected_generic or cloudflare_challenge, or carried a DataDome, PerimeterX or Kasada signal (and the three vendor challenges sent with 429, #712); their url, request and predicates are copied from tasks.v1.json unchanged. Tasks with origin real were added from public pages a probe found challenged on 2026-10-25; origin vendor_demo are vendor or practice demo pages, the only pages found for Turnstile, reCAPTCHA, hCaptcha and GeeTest: they are test pages, reported apart from the real pages and never added to their numbers. Each task's predicates fail on the challenge page the probe captured; challenge.primaryType is the type most often seen in the saved runs (the probe's when no run saw one), unknown when neither names it. Method and candidates: research/access/runs/2026-10-25-captcha-task-set.md.
manifestRule: manifestSha256 is the SHA-256 of JSON.stringify(tasks) (captchaReport.mjs manifestText): the tasks array, in file order, as JavaScript serialises it
